versions.changelog: Security: scoped API key to MINIMAX only, pinned LLM endpoint. TP4: removed unimplemented Gmail/WhatsApp/CRM/Stripe/project-board/Slack/Calendly/Telegram. LP3: added permissions + privacy notice. SQP-2: added privacy to marketing. Removed phantom Pro tier claim.

Initial release of smb-client-onboarding: automate new client setup for agencies, consultants, and freelancers.

- End-to-end workflow: from signed contract to activated client in 24 hours
- Automates welcome emails, WhatsApp messages, document collection, payment setup, calendar invites, project board creation, and team notifications
- Highly configurable for different industries and service types
- Saves 5–10 hours per new client onboarding
- Integrates with Gmail/Outlook, Google Calendar, HubSpot/Pipedrive, Stripe, Slack, Trello/Asana, and more
